package.meaning: Native PTSIP Package distribution identity. Output names and metadata use its deterministic platform-format representation.

tool.meaning: PTSIP Tool runtime identity, projected into the Go executable. It does not own the Package version.

RBAC.meaning: Versions of the three registered RA/RAC/AEC structural contracts, with no separate RBAC release version.

common_contract.meaning: Revision of the Common Contract registry manifest. Its individual contract versions remain in their separately owned schema bindings.

engines.meaning: Current version per official engine, with exact identity equality across its implementation and current capability contract.

schemas.meaning: Versions of the non-RBAC current product schema resources listed here. Use quoted canonical config keys in TOML.

initial_projection_rules: Engine contract version is already the approved baseline; verify exact equality and leave its bytes unchanged on initial cutover.

Project six engine versions into the index, current manifest implementation_version, binding engine_version, engine-local version.yaml, and that engine's own Cargo package row in Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock.
Verify current RBAC, Common Contract and schema version equality with their explicit registered owners; leave their existing bytes unchanged on initial cutover.
Resolve current Profile from the registered schema key. No standalone Profile version or fallback.
Read historical Git revisions with their historical parser only; reject the historical shape as the current source after cutover.
Use the exact declared owner mapping for future updates. Fail before writing on missing, ambiguous or incompatible owner mapping or inability to preserve the original schema and reference closure.

asset_delivery.source_archive_inputs: Exact tracked source allowlist containing approved builder inputs, Go source/modules/embedded assets and Rust sources/locked dependencies plus the same runtime asset reference closure used for the wheel.
asset_delivery.binary_build_inputs: Git-bound source archive or checked-out source of the exact verified final revision; archive verification preserves the source binding.
asset_delivery.closure_rule: Follow exact registered schema, engine manifest, capability, binding, transport, registry and owner-projected Support Policy references, including registered immutable Profile history. Include separately required installed resources by exact verifier and live consumer evidence. Reject missing, ambiguous, stale, unverified, developer-private, or out-of-root members.
asset_delivery.frontend_role: PEP 517 transport and retained package metadata only. Materialize its package version from src/VERSION; verify wheel name, dist-info path, METADATA and RECORD against the builder's same source and fail on disagreement.
asset_delivery.remove_tables_after: Machine-proven replacement archive and installed runtime coverage of all required previous consumers, with explicit retirement records for unnecessary members.
asset_delivery.preserve_package_history_semantics: Integrated product distribution and auxiliary Profile or Tool packages keep their distinct declared inventories; do not widen standalone delivery or activation.
asset_delivery.retire_legacy_specdata_when: Honor the schema-centralization plan's per-asset consumer closure. Keep the withdrawn duplicate retired and preserve unresolved sources until verified replacement or authorized retirement.

release_composition.retired_policy_reference: MPD-INFO-0005 has lifecycle RETIRED. Do not copy its pyproject version authority into the replacement.

required_contract_records.version_source: Exact src/VERSION path and owner-bound section mapping for package, tool, RBAC, common_contract, engines and schemas.
required_contract_records.registered_sources: Exact engine index, schema config and Common Contract registry refs. Assert identity, versions, digest and current source requirements at selection.
required_contract_records.build_projection: Exact native builder/assembly paths, actual target platform, package name/version, compiled engine versions, component SHA-256 and RECORD.
required_contract_records.verification_gates: Existing build, verification boundary, mode registry, release admission and artifact identity checks. Bind independent snapshot and applicable dependency graph verification to exact final source SHA.
required_contract_records.artifact_receipt: Exact final committed source SHA, verified snapshot digest, component inventory, wheel filename, platform and SHA-256. Fail closed on absent, stale or mismatching evidence.
required_contract_records.publication_boundary: Verify and preserve immutable published state and package registry receipts. This contract grants no runtime activation or publication.

release_composition.release_state_migration: Preserve independently installed or published original-source composition and digest evidence via the existing release-state registry. Rebind active version readers and publication-state readers/writers to their registered owners before removing pyproject composition tables or the retired contract.
release_composition.acceptance: Update registered routing, controller and workflow checks together. Prove replacement fixture validation and selection, exact version/source binding, negative mismatch cases, historical read-only behavior, and zero live callers before contractual retirement.

before_implementation: Review the exact initial section values and owner mappings against the six current registered Engine contracts, schema config and Common Contract registry.
Review the existing asset and release consumer inventory including standalone verification, preserving registered paths, evidence and existing gates.
Confirm no active policy conflict in the selected initial scope. Leave future unsupported UP-05 cases blocked.
Record the audited plan revision, approved scope and implementation authorization explicitly. The decision delegation itself does not record this approval.
after_implementation_before_cutover: Pass strict TOML shape, valid and invalid version cases and historical-read tests.
Pass deterministic sync checks for manifest, binding, Cargo, index and version metadata. Verify canonical contract and existing history bytes are preserved.
Validate the new release composition route and all affected consumers, with no loss of verification or publication evidence.
Prove required artifact member and digest parity via registered build verification before removing legacy package-data tables.
full_plan_approval_conditions.operational_sequence: Use resolved UP-01 and VC-10. Complete the independent snapshot job and final exact clean source verification before building the wheel. Keep dependency graph verification as a separate job and publication subject to its own authorization.
full_plan_approval_conditions.no_unverified_claims: A design decision, local simulation, historical acceptance, source-only test or staged implementation does not admit production use or release.
